test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 06 Feb 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in the bracket to fill in the blank.**

She looks like a young Sigourney Weaver and plays the (naïve) ______ heroine well, if a little too credulous for my taste.
solution: The correct answer is** "sophisticated."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Naive" **means having or showing a lack of experience, judgment, or information; credulous. (अनुभव, निर्णय या जानकारी की कमी होना या प्रदर्शित होना; विश्रंभी) • **Example**: *She's so **naive**__ she believes everything she reads.* • **"Sophisticated"** is the antonym of **"naive."** • **"Sophisticated" **means knowledgeable, refined, or worldly-wise. (जानकार, परिष्कृत, या सांसारिक-समझदार) __ • **Example**: *The **sophisticated**__ businesswoman knew exactly how to handle the difficult situation.* • The correct answer is Option 2. **Correct sentence**: *She looks like a young Sigourney Weaver and plays the __**sophisticated**__ heroine well, if a little too credulous for my taste.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1, childish**, means immature or silly. (बचकाना; नासमझी का) • **Option 3, tricked**, means deceived or fooled. (किसी से छल करना) • **Option 4, careless**, means negligent or not paying attention. (असावधान, लापरवाह) 186:T11aa, The correct answer is **"tests."**
